whatIsIt.eli5: Looks at bigger and bigger areas and joins what it found, like SPPF.
whatIsIt.simple: YOLOv9's version of SPPF: a 1×1 Conv, three 5×5 max-pools in a row, join all four maps, 1×1 Conv.
whatIsIt.engineer: cv1 Conv1×1(c3) → 3 × MaxPool(5, 1, 2) chained → cat (4·c3) → cv5 Conv1×1(c2).

whyExists.eli5: Each spot gets a summary of a big area for free.
whyExists.simple: Adds multi-scale context at the end of the backbone with almost no learned weights.
whyExists.engineer: SPP/ELAN hybrid; inner width c3 is a free argument.

eli5: Keep the strongest in bigger and bigger squares.
engineer: Equivalent to SPPF with a configurable hidden width.

example.eli5: YOLOv9t uses it at the end of the backbone.
example.simple: YOLOv9t layer 9: 128 channels at 20×20, c3 = 64, 41,344 parameters.
